Description: This recall involves the small Stratton pendant light fixtures. The lights are suspended and provide task lighting and general illumination for both consumer and commercial applications. The UPC number is on the light fixture packaging, and the part number is located on a yellow sticker inside of the canopy of the fixture. The recalled small light fixture is 9.2 inches wide, and was sold with a glass shade (clear or smoke color). Title: Generation Brands Recalls Glass Pendant Light Fixtures Due to Risk of Injury
ConsumerContact: Tech Lighting toll-free at 888-475-1136 from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. CT Monday through Friday or online at www.techlighting.com and click on the recall button at the bottom of the home page for more information.

Products.Name: Small Stratton glass pendant light fixtures
Products.NumberOfUnits: About 1,200 (in addition, 30 units were sold in Canada)

Injuries.Name: The firm has received one report of the glass pendant detaching from the light fixture, resulting in injury to a bystander standing directly beneath it.

Manufacturers.Name: Guangzhou Xiongyi Precision Metalworking Co., Ltd., of China

Retailers.Name: Independent lighting retailers nationwide and online at build.com, Circa Lighting, Lightology, Lumens, Wayfair, and Y Lighting from January 2013 through December 2018 for between $385 and $525.

Importers.Name: Tech Lighting LLC, a division of Generation Brands, of Skokie, Illinois

Hazards.Name: The small glass pendant light fixtures can detach from their electrical cord, causing the fixture to fall unexpectedly, posing a risk of injury from impact.

Remedies.Name: Consumers should immediately prevent people from going under the light fixture and contact Tech Lighting to receive a free repair kit. Consumers will need to schedule installation of the repair kit by a certified electrician, and Tech Lighting will reimburse the consumer for the service.
